mapper.select: SELECT HUR.REQUEST_ID AS requestId, HUR.HOSPITAL_ID AS hospitalId, HUR.MEMBER_ID AS memberId, HUR.REQUEST_TYPE AS requestType, HUR.STATUS AS requestStatus, HUR.APPLICANT_NAME AS applicantName, NVL( M.NICKNAME, NVL(H.OWNER_NAME, '병원장 미등록')) AS ownerName, M.EMAIL AS ownerEmail, HUR.BUSINESS_NUMBER AS businessNumber, HUR.DOCUMENT_URL AS documentUrl, HUR.REQUEST_REASON AS requestReason, HUR.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason, HUR.CREATED_AT AS createdAt, HUR.PROCESSED_AT AS processedAt, HUR.PROCESSED_BY AS processedBy, H.STATUS AS currentHospitalStatus, H.NAME AS currentHospitalName, H.ADDRESS AS currentHospitalAddress, H.DETAIL_ADDRESS AS currentHospitalDetailAddress, H.DISTRICT AS currentHospitalDistrict, H.WEBSITE_URL AS currentHospitalWebsiteUrl, H.IMAGE_URL AS currentHospitalImageUrl, HUR.HOSPITAL_NAME AS requestedHospitalName, HUR.HOSPITAL_ADDRESS AS requestedHospitalAddress, HUR.HOSPITAL_DETAIL_ADDRESS AS requestedHospitalDetailAddress, HUR.HOSPITAL_DISTRICT AS requestedHospitalDistrict, HUR.HOSPITAL_WEBSITE_URL AS requestedHospitalWebsiteUrl, HUR.HOSPITAL_IMAGE_URL AS requestedHospitalImageUrl, HUR.TEMP_CLOSE_START_AT AS tempCloseStartAt, HUR.TEMP_CLOSE_END_AT AS tempCloseEndAt FROM HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST HUR JOIN HOSPITAL H ON H.HOSPITAL_ID = HUR.HOSPITAL_ID LEFT JOIN APP_MEMBER M ON M.MEMBER_ID = H.OWNER_ID WHERE HUR.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId}

SELECT REQUEST_ID AS requestId, HOSPITAL_ID AS hospitalId, REQUEST_TYPE AS requestType, STATUS AS requestStatus, TEMP_CLOSE_START_AT AS tempCloseStartAt, TEMP_CLOSE_END_AT AS tempCloseEndAt FROM HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE HOSPITAL H SET( OWNER_NAME, NAME,ADDRESS,DETAIL_ADDRESS, DISTRICT, WEBSITE_URL, LATITUDE, LONGITUDE,IMAGE_URL) = ( SELECT HUR.APPLICANT_NAME, HUR.HOSPITAL_NAME, HUR.HOSPITAL_ADDRESS, HUR.HOSPITAL_DETAIL_ADDRESS, HUR.HOSPITAL_DISTRICT, HUR.HOSPITAL_WEBSITE_URL, HUR.HOSPITAL_LATITUDE, HUR.HOSPITAL_LONGITUDE, HUR.HOSPITAL_IMAGE_URL FROM HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST HUR WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND HUR.HOSPITAL_ID = H.HOSPITAL_ID AND HUR.REQUEST_TYPE = 'UPDATE' AND HUR.STATUS = 'PENDING') WHERE H.STATUS IN('OPEN', 'TEMP_CLOSED') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST HUR WHERE HUR.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND HUR.HOSPITAL_ID = H.HOSPITAL_ID AND HUR.REQUEST_TYPE = 'UPDATE' AND HUR.STATUS = 'PENDING' )

UPDATE HOSPITAL H SET STATUS = 'CLOSED' WHERE H.STATUS IN ('OPEN', 'TEMP_CLOSED') AND EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST HUR WHERE HUR.REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND HUR.HOSPITAL_ID = H.HOSPITAL_ID AND HUR.REQUEST_TYPE = 'CLOSE' AND HUR.STATUS = 'PENDING' )
UPDATE HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'APPROVED', PROCESSED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, PROCESSED_BY = #{processedBy}, REJECT_REASON = NULL WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'

UPDATE HOSPITAL_UPDATE_REQUEST SET STATUS = 'REJECTED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason}, PROCESSED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP, PROCESSED_BY = #{processedBy} WHERE REQUEST_ID = #{requestId} AND STATUS = 'PENDING'
